AiAssistantScreen.title: AI assistant
AiAssistantScreen.description: Use the AI assistant you already have (Claude, ChatGPT or another) inside TManage. It can search, read your work, create tasks and comment, always with your permissions and nothing more.
AiAssistantScreen.step1Body: A key lets your assistant sign in to TManage as you. It can only do what you can do, and you can switch it off at any time.
AiAssistantScreen.step2Body: Copy the settings below into Claude, ChatGPT or any assistant that supports MCP connectors.
AiAssistantScreen.step3Body: For example: “What is overdue for me this week?” or “Create a task to review the homepage copy.”
AiAssistantScreen.noChargeNote: TManage does not charge for AI and does not send your work to an AI company. Your own assistant does the thinking, under your own account with that company.
AiAssistantScreen.keyFilledNote: When you create a key, it is filled in here for you.

MarketingHomeScreen.heroEyebrow: Work operating system for service teams and their clients
MarketingHomeScreen.chain1Title: The client asks in their portal
MarketingHomeScreen.chain1Body: Desired date recorded as a wish, never as a promise.
MarketingHomeScreen.chain2Title: The team clarifies in a thread
MarketingHomeScreen.chain2Body: The thread stays attached to the request forever.
MarketingHomeScreen.chain3Body: Committed, forecast and desired are three separate fields.
MarketingHomeScreen.chain4Body: Milestones move on evidence, not on task percentages.
MarketingHomeScreen.chain5Body: The author cannot approve their own work.
MarketingHomeScreen.chain6Body: You see the client’s exact view before you send it.
MarketingHomeScreen.chain7Body: Change the file and the approval is invalidated, not overwritten.
MarketingHomeScreen.chain8Body: Answers cite the objects you are allowed to see.
MarketingHomeScreen.productLede: Most tools lose the thread between the ask and the delivery. TManage keeps one chain of custody: every object below is the same record, seen from a different angle.
MarketingHomeScreen.productRemovesBody: Status meetings to find out where things are. Screenshots pasted into email. “Which version did you approve?” Spreadsheets that track other spreadsheets.
MarketingHomeScreen.portalHeading: Your client logs in and knows where things stand in thirty seconds.
MarketingHomeScreen.portalLede: One stage track, one number that matters, and the actions that belong to them. No module names, no empty tabs, no controls they cannot use.
MarketingHomeScreen.portalPoint0: Progress from milestone evidence, not task counts
MarketingHomeScreen.portalPoint1: Approvals bound to the exact version they reviewed
MarketingHomeScreen.portalPoint2: Generated from an allowlist — internal work is invisible, not hidden
MarketingHomeScreen.previewAria: Illustration of what a client sees
